name: via
description: Claude Code leads; Codex, Gemini (Antigravity), OpenCode and pi do the work as native subagents on your own login, saving Claude's tokens and context.

defaultModel.title: Default pi model
defaultModel.description: pi --model pattern used when a prompt has no model: line. Empty: pi's own default (defaultModel in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json).

timeoutMinutes.title: Time limit (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A harness run longer than this is stopped and its partial output returned.

codexAcp.title: Codex ACP adapter
codexAcp.description: pinned (default): the codex-acp version via ships with, its whole dependency tree locked and verified, installed once. latest: install the newest codex-acp once per Claude Code session, its dependencies unpinned.
